summary.text: Thomas Cormen is a Democratic state representative from New Hampshire who is seeking re-election in Grafton 17 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an emeritus professor of computer science at Dartmouth College and a textbook author.

paragraphs.text: Thomas Cormen's career includes serving as a professor and as chair of the computer science department at Dartmouth College, where he is now emeritus, and as the founding director of the Dartmouth College Institute for Writing and Rhetoric.
He is also a textbook author and has served as co-chair of the Lebanon Master Plan Economic Development Subcommittee.
Cormen won election to the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Grafton 15 in November 2022, defeating Independent Nick Mouzourakis, and was re-elected in November 2024.
In the 2023-2024 term he was assigned to the Science, Technology and Energy Committee.
He advanced from the Democratic primary for Grafton 17 on September 8, 2026, and no Republican appeared on the primary ballot for that district.
